interpretation: Leukocyte score is significantly elevated in LPD dialysate effluent (P = 0.0010), demonstrating substantial inflammatory cellular influx. After adjusting for leukocyte score as a covariate: TNFSF15 (P = 0.0036), CXCL14 (P = 0.0130), FLT3LG (P = 0.0167), and ADAM19 (P = 0.0400) remain robustly significant, proving that their pro-fibrotic upregulation is not merely an artifact of leukocyte infiltration. In contrast, EBI3 (P = 0.0532) becomes borderline, while SERPINA10 (P = 0.216) and LTB (P = 0.337) attenuate substantially, indicating that their apparent elevation in effluent is partially confounded by the leukocyte compartment.
